headlines.text: Flash back to 2019, when the inaugural AEW World Tag Team Titles was crowned as SCU (Kaz & Sky) vs. The Lucha Brothers went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.31 ? a well-worked match. The tournament final that crowned AEW's first-ever World Tag Team Champions ? an amped crowd chanted along throughout a back-and-forth war before Sky sealed history with a small package on Pentagon Jr.

On a Wednesday in 2024, back when a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Private Party vs. The Young Bucks battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? a fantastic contest ? ending the champion's reign at 12 defenses. With the stipulation that a loss would force them to split up forever, Kassidy and Quen overcame Okada's interference to win the AEW World Tag Team Titles from the Young Bucks, who handed over the belts in a show of respect.
Back on this day in 2019, Angelico & Evans left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Hybrid2 after 2 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.
